title: Translation round-trip fidelity
description: You usually cannot read the language you are translating into, so the only mechanical check available is a round trip: translate out, translate back, and require that the load-bearing terms survived. Product names, identifiers and negations are what break, and a negation that flips is a support ticket that means the opposite of what the customer wrote.

cases.input: The Zephyr X200 router rejected the firmware update on port 8080.
The refund was not processed and the account has not been closed.
Your invoice for 3 seats totals 149 dollars and is due on the 14th.
